meta.title: Redpine Fire at Redpine National Forest
meta.subtitle: Wildfire | Ashcombe area | Date and time unspecified

bullets.text: The Redpine Fire was active around Redpine National Forest and Route 9, with the fire authority estimating 1,800 hectares burned and no containment.
A mandatory evacuation order covered all of Ashford Mill and zones C1 through C4.
Route 9 south was used as an evacuation route and was later confirmed closed for evacuation efforts.
Public-safety reporting included smoke advisories, boil-water notices, dangerous-condition alerts, and possible power disruption.
An evening fire-authority update said growth was slowing at Redpine National Forest.
A contemporaneous post stated that a wildfire was happening at Redpine National Forest.
bullets.time: Right now, date and timezone unspecified
